control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$R/events/count" --expect 200
control-agent-server state ls 'server/workspace/conversations/*/owner_lease.json' --expect-min 2
ER=$(control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$R/events/count" --field .)
COUNT=$(control-agent-server api GET <redacted:session-cookie>/count --field .)
control-agent-server api POST <redacted:session-cookie>/prepare-for-sandbox-pause --auth none --expect 401 --check detail eq Unauthorized
control-agent-server state ls 'server/workspace/conversations/*/owner_lease.json' --expect-min 2
control-agent-server api POST <redacted:session-cookie>/prepare-for-sandbox-pause --expect 204 --save F12.sandbox-pause-releases/pause \
  | jq -e '.response.body == ""'
control-agent-server state ls 'server/workspace/conversations/*/owner_lease.json' --expect-count 0
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$N" --expect 200 --check execution_status eq idle
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$R" --expect 200 --check execution_status eq finished --save F12.sandbox-pause-releases/after
control-agent-server api GET <redacted:session-cookie>/count --check . eq "$COUNT"
control-agent-server api POST <redacted:session-cookie>/prepare-for-sandbox-pause --expect 204
